programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can effect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler into a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: South Park: The List
programme.desc: The List: The boys steal a list from the girls which rates their looks from the cutest to the ugliest. Spirits plummet, while for others egos inflate! Can the ghost of Abraham Lincoln help? (S11, E14)

programme.title: South Park: Tonsil Trouble
programme.desc: Tonsil Trouble: A botched blood transfusion results in Cartman getting AIDS. How far will he go to find a cure? Kyle had better watch out... (S12, E01)

programme.title: South Park: Britney's New Look
programme.desc: Britney's New Look: The media circus arrives in South Park as Britney Spears hides in the town. After a photo of her urinating on a ladybug sells for $100,000 the boys have a brain wave. (S12, E02)

programme.title: South Park: Major B**bage
programme.desc: Major B**bage: The hysterical parents of South Park have another reason to panic after 'cheesing' becomes popular among kids. Kenny becomes addicted to the out-of-this-world hallucinations. (S12, E03)

programme.title: South Park: Canada on Strike
programme.desc: Canada on Strike: Canada is brought to the brink of collapse after a drawn out strike in pursuit of 'some of that internet money'. Can the boys save the day with a "YouToob" sensation? (S12, E04)

programme.title: South Park: Eek, A Pen*s!
programme.desc: Eek, A Pen*s! Ms. Garrison wants to become a man again, so whilst she is away Cartman becomes the sub teacher. It's not long before Cartman is teaching innercity kids the fun of cheating! (S12, E05)

programme.title: South Park: Hotter than Summer: Over Logging
programme.desc: Over Logging: Panic reigns as South Park finds that the internet's gone! The Marshes decide to go hunting for the internet in California and end up in an "internet refugee camp". (S12, E06)

programme.title: South Park: Super Fun Time
programme.desc: Super Fun Time: The kids go on a field trip to a 'living museum'. A hostage situation ensues when robbers use the place to evade police. It's up to Cartman and Butters to save the day! (S12, E07)

programme.title: South Park: The China Probrem
programme.desc: The China Probrem: Alarmed by the grandeur of the Olympic ceremonies, Cartman enlists Butters to help him confront the Chinese. (S12, E08)

programme.title: South Park: Breast Cancer Show Ever
programme.desc: Breast Cancer Show Ever: Cartman's reputation is at stake when he is too afraid to fight Wendy, who is furious about his breast cancer jibes. Cartman then takes things from bad to worse! (S12, E09)

programme.title: South Park: Pandemic (Part 1)
programme.desc: Pandemic (1): South Park goes all 'Cloverfield' when large, mysterious creatures begin causing havoc around the globe, all caught on Randy's shaky cam. The boys start a Peruvian flute band. (S12, E10)

programme.title: South Park: Pandemic 2: The Startling (Part 2)
programme.desc: Pandemic 2 - The Startling (2): Giant guinea pigs are attacking cities around the world. The boys have the key which will save humanity, but they are stuck in the Andes and bored to boot! (S12, E11)

programme.title: South Park: About Last Night...
programme.desc: About Last Night...: While the country celebrates the election of Obama, a band of unlikely super-thieves begin an audacious jewel heist. The town's Republicans fear the apocalypse is nigh. (S12, E12)

programme.title: South Park: Elementary School Musical
programme.desc: Elementary School Musical: When the all-singing and dancing musical craze hits South Park, the boys must embrace it or relinquish their popularity. Will they stick to their guns? (S12, E13)

programme.title: South Park: The Ungroundable
programme.desc: The Ungroundable: Fed up with how he is treated by his parents, the eternally innocent Butters embraces the new vampire craze a little too enthusiastically. Who will he choose to feed on? (S12, E14)

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: The Ring: To the amazement of the boys Kenny has a girlfriend, but they must face the might of Disney and its leader to free Kenny from the powers of his libido-squashing purity ring. (S13, E01)

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: The 'C**n: By day he is Eric Cartman, a fat fourth-grader. By night, he is The C**n, a crime fighting vigilante dressed in a raccoon outfit, desperate for attention. But who is Mysterion? (S13, E02)

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Margaritaville: In a riff on the story of Christ, Randy implores the town to stop angering the economy with rash purchases, but a young Jew, Kyle, challenges this orthodox teaching. (S13, E03)

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Eat, Pray, Queef: When a new Canadian show called The Queef Sisters starts a 'queefing' craze the men of South Park are disgusted by this new female craze and move to get it banned. (S13, E04)

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Fishsticks: Jimmy is angry that Cartman tries to take credit for a joke he created that is now sweeping the nation. But an angry Kanye West just can't get his head around the punch line. (S13, E05)

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Pinewood Derby: Randy and Stan somehow discover warp speed, allowing Earth to join the Galactic Federation of Planets, but will an alien gangster and his 'space cash' ruin everything? (S13, E06)

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Fatbeard: Cartman hears of all the riches being plundered by the pirates in Somalia, so dons his eye patch and leads a motley crew off to Africa to get in on the act. (S13, E07)

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Dead Celebrities: The ghost of Michael Jackson refuses to accept his death, leaving the rest of the recently dead celebrities frustrated in purgatory and poor Ike having ghostly visits! (S13, E08)

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Butter's Bottom B***h: Oblivious to his actions, the little innocent Butters starts up 'The Kissing Company', and is soon the most notorious pimp around. Will undercover cops ruin his fun? (S13, E09)
programme.sub-title: Hotter than Summer: Butters' Bottom Bitch

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: W. T. F.: After seeing their first live WWE wrestling match the boys decide to form their own wrestling federation... and gain a huge redneck following! (S13, E10)

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Whale W****s: Kyle joins the crew of a reality documentary show who confront Japanese whalers, but finds their tactics leave a lot to be desired for and that war with Japan beckons! (S13, E11)

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: The F Word: The boys confront a group of obnoxious bikers, but their methods force the townsfolk to redefine the meaning of a rather offensive word. Time to update the English Dictionary! (S13, E12)

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Dances With Smurfs: Cartman's vitriol finally gets a platform when he is chosen to be the school's morning announcer, and he unashamedly abuses his position. Power corrupts... (S13, E13)

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Pee: High levels of pee in the pool cause a disaster which ruins the day for the boys, Kyle especially. Eric's xenophobia pops up again when he believes himself "the last of his species". (S13, E14)

programme.title: South Park: Weight Gain 4000
programme.desc: Weight Gain 4000: Cartman wins a school essay competition by cheating and decides to buff up before receiving his award from Kathy Lee Gifford. Mr. Garrison and Mr. Hat plot to kill her! (S1, E02)

programme.title: South Park: Cartman Gets an Anal Probe
programme.desc: Cartman Gets An Anal Probe: Cartman dreams he has a close encounter with an alien. The other boys are convinced the dream was real, and that he has been the victim of an alien anal probe. (S1, E01)

programme.title: South Park: Volcano
programme.desc: Volcano: The boys go on a hunting trip with Stan's Uncle Jimbo to find the famous Scuzzlebutt. They are unaware that the mountain they are hunting on is a volcano on the verge of erupting! (S1, E03)

programme.title: South Park: An Elephant Makes Love to a Pig
programme.desc: An Elephant Makes Love To A Pig: Kyle calls in genetic engineer Dr. Mephisto to crossbreed his pet elephant and Cartman's pot-bellied pig in a bid to win a science competition. (S1, E05)
programme.sub-title: An Elephant Makes Love to a Pig

programme.title: South Park: Death
programme.desc: Death: Stan's ancient grandfather attempts to trick the boys into killing him. Meanwhile, the parents of South Park lobby a TV network to rid the airwaves of Terrance and Phillip. (S1, E06)

programme.title: South Park: Pink Eye
programme.desc: Pink Eye: It's Halloween and Kenny is killed by a falling space station and turned into a zombie by some embalming fluid contaminated with Worcester sauce. The zombie disease spreads. (S1, E07)

programme.title: South Park: Damien
programme.desc: Damien: The new kid in class persuades Jesus to do battle with his father, Satan, in the final battle of good versus evil. Cartman is livid to learn the bout clashes with his birthday. (S1, E10)

programme.title: South Park: Starvin' Marvin
programme.desc: Starvin' Marvin: During a Terrance & Phillip ad-break the boys decide to adopt an Ethiopian child, swayed by the promise of a free digital watch. Mobs of wild turkeys rampage through town! (S1, E08)

programme.title: South Park: Mr. Hankey the Christmas Poo
programme.desc: Mr Hankey, The Christmas Poo: The Mayor decides to impose a holiday theme which won't offend anybody. Kyle tries to convince everyone that Mr Hankey (a singing Christmas poo) exists. (S1, E09)

programme.desc: La policía detiene a un psicópata al que se le relaciona con múltiples raptos y asesinatos de mujeres, pero su captura será solo el principio de una cuenta atrás en busca de sus víctimas

programme.title: Atrapada en Guantánamo
programme.desc: Una guardia en Bahía Guantánamo inicia una extraña amistad con uno de los detenidos más antiguos en la instalación.

programme.title: El transportador 3
programme.desc: Frank Martin es un indiscutible especialista en entregas de alto riesgo. En esta ocasión está obligado bajo amenazas a trasladar dos voluminosas bolsas y una joven ucraniana desde Marsella hasta Odessa

programme.title: CAOS
programme.desc: Dos policías, un novato (Phillipe) y un veterano (Statham) persiguen a un exitoso ladrón de bancos (Snipes)

programme.title: Peligro en la montaña
programme.desc: Joe Braven es un humilde leñador que vive en la frontera de los Estados Unidos. Cuando es asaltado por un grupo de traficantes de drogas en la recluida cabaña donde vive, hará todo lo que puede para proteger a su familia.

programme.title: EL Rascacielos
programme.desc: Una guerra de clases se desata en una propiedad residencial de lujo y se desarrolla una verdadera batalla en los ascensores, pasillos y apartamentos de la moderna torre.

programme.title: Killer Shark
programme.desc: Un grupo de amigos que estaban de vacaciones en un yate privado se quedan varados en medio del mar. Lo peor es que un gigantesco tiburón mutado los ataca. Ahora deben luchar para sobrevivir tanto al tiburón como a otros desafíos que les esperan.

programme.title: Amenaza en el Espacio
programme.desc: En la cúspide de la paternidad, un mecánico junior a bordo de un arca interestelar a la Nueva Tierra debe burlar un terror cósmico malévolo intención de utilizar la nave espacial como un arma.

programme.title: La Puerta
programme.desc: La remoción de un viajo árbol en el patio trasero de una residencia suburbana revela un agujero grande y misterioso que resulta ser una cámara subterránea de un terrorífico mal demoníaco.

programme.title: Programa AND
programme.desc: Cuando un humilde cartero es incluido en un programa de ADN sobrehumano ultrasecreto en un centro de investigación, se revela que podrá recibir, controlar y enviar información basada en los sentidos de los demás.

programme.title: La Fuente de la Vida
programme.desc: Con las actuaciones de Hugh Jackman y Rachel Weisz, se entreteje un cuento acerca de la búsqueda de un hombre por encontrar "el árbol de la vida" que le dará vida eterna.

programme.title: Head On A Plate
programme.desc: Un alienígena del espacio exterior que cambia de forma causa estragos en un pequeño pueblo rural en el suroeste de Estados Unidos, cerca de la legendaria Área 51 famosa por los ovnis.

programme.title: The Arrival
programme.desc: El astrónomo de radio Zane Zaminsky cree que ha captado un ruido cósmico que señala inteligencia extraterrestre.

programme.title: Pánico en Seattle
programme.desc: Cuando una gran tormenta amenaza el Noroeste del Pacífico, una familia debe encontrarse y trabajar en conjunto para detenerla antes de que se salga de control y aniquile a todo el planeta.

programme.title: Alien: Bellezas mortales
programme.desc: Luke y Roger son sólo otro par de universitarios tratando de perder su virginidad. Pero cuando Luke ve algo inusual, comienza a sospechar que las chicas del campus no son exactamente... humanas.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: En este mundo, la verdadera maldad existe. Acecha dentro de las sombras más oscuras, así como en los lugares más sencillos. Se disfraza con muchas máscaras para engañarnos y, finalmente, destruirnos.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: La ciencia moderna nos afirma que, en el nivel más simple, el mundo material no es más que energía y que todos estamos conectados de forma física con el mundo que nos rodea.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Ron y Nancy están convencidos de que su nuevo hogar es demasiado bueno para ser verdad: la histórica casa Baltimore se adapta de forma ideal a su presupuesto y además es tan grande como para alojar a su gran familia.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Existen algunos lazos que no pueden romperse, tal como el vínculo que se establece entre una madre y su hija... o el vínculo psíquico entre un asesino y su víctima.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Cuando Clara y su familia se mudan a una pequeña casa en la zona rural de Hinsdale, Nueva York, se dan cuenta de que la paz de la vida en el campo es simplemente una ilusión y la amenaza de muerte es muy real.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: La casa de rancho de Ed y Beth parece el lugar perfecto para criar a su niño pequeño, hasta que descubren que no están solos y una espesa niebla oscura se cierne sobre la casa y crece día a día.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: En la vida, las personas pueden vivir atormentadas por sus propios crímenes. Lo mismo también puede ocurrir en la muerte: espíritus enojados pueden quedar estacionados en el mismo lugar donde perdieron su humanidad.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: ¿Qué tan diferente podría ser nuestra realidad si no pudiéramos sentir y comunicarnos de las formas más convencionales? Para Marie, este es un tema que forma parte de su día a día. Su hija Julie padece una condición mental que la debilita.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Algunas personas creen que los fantasmas son espíritus humanos que deben lidiar con asuntos aún pendientes y que quizás puedan necesitar la ayuda de los vivos, con el fin de encontrar la paz entre los muertos.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Deb y Tony acaban de comenzar su vida juntos. Con su primer hijo en camino, la pareja trabajadora se muda a una pintoresca casa en Atchison, en el estado de Kansas, con muchas esperanzas en el futuro.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: En la isla de Taiwán muchas personas creen que no existen fronteras entre el mundo material y el reino espiritual. Los fantasmas forman parte de la vida cotidiana.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Hay un demonio suelto en una casa de Connecticut, y un niño de 12 años se lleva la peor parte de su ira. Él ve a un anciano con pezuñas y cuernos, lo golpean y lo arrojan y finalmente es poseído. Solo un exorcismo salvará su alma.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Se ha dicho que cada fotografía roba una parte del alma de un hombre. Entonces, ¿qué ocurre con todas esas partes cuando la persona ya ha fallecido?

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Los niños a menudo se encuentran a merced del mundo de los adultos y, algunas veces, se sienten incapaces de influir en el curso de sus propias existencias.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: En la inocencia de la infancia, el miedo es perfecto, y no resulta influenciado por la racionalidad adulta, lo cual supone que se puede comprender a cabalidad el mundo que nos rodea.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Algunas personas creen que todo nuestro conocimiento del mundo nos llega a través de la percepción sensorial y los poderes del razonamiento. Otras, en cambio, piensan que podemos obtener conocimiento por medio de la intuición.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: La dinámica de las personas que viven bajo un mismo techo puede tener un equilibrio delicado. Mike y su novia, Lisa, mantienen una relación sana y, sin nada que les preocupe, se mudan juntos, pero no están solos en su nueva casa.

programme.title: Capulina contra Los Monstruos
programme.desc: Capulina lee historias acerca de los monstrous y cree que existen en la realidad. Está muerto de miedo hasta que descubre que son imaginarios.

programme.title: Capulina contra Los Vampiros
programme.desc: Vampiros agresivos amenazan a Capulina hasta que él encuentra la manera de arrancarles los colmillos con unas pinzas de dentista. Los vampiros chimuelos se vuelven dóciles y beben leche en lugar de sangre.

programme.title: Capulina corazón de león
programme.desc: Capulina accidentalmente adopta un león de una tienda de mascotas, pensando que es un gato. Las cosas se complican cuando, encima de todo, lo toman por asaltante.

programme.title: Capulina vs las momias
programme.desc: Un taxista lleva hasta Guanajuato al sobrino de un científico que busca en las momias el secreto de la vida.

programme.title: Chabelo y pepito detectives
programme.desc: Un comandante amigo de Chabelo y Pepito les pide que lo ayuden a descubrir una banda que secuestra niños. Ellos aceptan y se infiltran en la banda para descubrir que los villanos son seres de otro planeta.

programme.title: Chabelo y Pepito en la lampara maravillosa
programme.desc: Pepito descubre que el objeto que compró es una lámpara maravillosa, y pide toda clase de deseos. Pero ahora que su padrastro lo sabe y la quiere usar para hacer el mal, deberá evitar que caiga en sus manos.

programme.title: Chabelo y Pepito vs los monstruos
programme.desc: Chabelo y Pepito van de excursión con un grupo de exploradores y se enfrentan al peligro en una cueva maldita. La aventura comienza cuando encuentran a varios monstruos y deciden destruirlos.

programme.title: Corona de lágrimas
programme.desc: Refugio trabaja como contadora para poder mantener a sus tres hijos. Sin embargo, la vida de todos da un giro cuando uno de ellos es llevado a la cárcel y tienen que resolver sus propios problemas.

programme.title: Cuidado con el Amor
programme.desc: Pedro, con la ayuda de dos mejores amigos de su padre busca un Tesoro enterrado en una hacienda colonial. Elsa y su madre quieren impedirlo. Al fin el amor interviene y Pedro y Elsa comparten la fortuna y su felicidad.

programme.title: Dos Criados Malcriados
programme.desc: Capulina y Viruta entran a trabajar como sirvientes en la lujosa mansión de un millonario. Son torpes y casi arruínan la casa, pero al fin todos encuentran felicidad y amor con dos guapas sirvientas.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Gerald se encuentra cara a cara con el Cazador de Trolls. Cartman teme que Heidi descubra su pasado. El director PC intenta lograr la paz entre los chicos y las chicas de la escuela.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Garrison, que recientemente recibió la apariencia de Donald Trump, ha sido electo como nuevo presidente de los Estados Unidos. Gerald intenta escapar del temido cazador de trolls danés.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman está seguro de que Butters está intentando robarle a su novia.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman intenta convencer a los científicos de que ir a Marte es una mala idea. Kyle y Ike desafían a su mamá e intentan, junto con todos los chicos, salvar al mundo de una destrucción segura.
programme.sub-title: El fin de la serialización tal como la conocemos

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman está cansado de su novia Heidi y comienza a enamorarse de Alexa, una inteligencia artificial. Mientras tanto, Randy y Sharon Marsh lanzan un programa de televisión en donde remodelan casas.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Corea del Norte apunta sus misiles hacia South Park. Mientras tanto, en la escuela hay una nueva campaña para incentivar el uso consciente del celular y Cartman inicia una campaña contra el suicidio.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Randy hará de todo para probar que tiene ADN de los nativos americanos en su cuerpo.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Coon y Amigos regresan con el pretencioso plan de ganar dinero con una franquicia de películas de superhéroes.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Es Halloween y los hombres de South Park celebran su encuentro anual del Día de las Brujas. Pero al leer un libro de hechizos, uno de ellos se convierte en un brujo de verdad.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman le echa la culpa de su mal humor a la comida chatarra y Heidi le propone iniciar una dieta juntos. Mientras, Kyle no entiende el motivo por el cual Cartman todavía quiere salir con Heidi.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El proyecto de Jimmy y Timmy puede ganar el primer premio en la feria anual de ciencias, y Nathan y Mimsy quieren sabotearlos. Mientras tanto, la relación de Heidi y Cartman es cada vez más abusiva.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El director PC se enamora de la nueva vice-directora de la escuela. Mientras tanto, Terrance y Phillip quieren firmar un contrato con Netflix, y Kyle está cansado de ser humillado por Heidi y Cartman.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los adultos de South Park están enojados ya que el presidente está asustando a sus hijos. Los niños parten con el fin de desentrañar el gran misterio de Garrison al estilo It y Stranger Things.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Randy está desesperado por ayudar a Sharon a controlar sus emociones y Cartman reprueba inesperadamente su examen de matemáticas.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Se ha desarrollado una relación muy especial entre Butters y el sacerdote de su parroquia.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El comportamiento ofensivo del Sr. Mojón lo pone en riesgo de ser despedido como director del espectáculo anual de Navidad.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Butters está vendiendo vaporizadores y todo tipo de sabores frutados en la escuela. Randy decide que debería mudar a la familia al campo y dedicarse a la agricultura.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los niños planean usar la última revolución en movilidad para obtener más dulces durante la Noche de Brujas de los que obtuvieron antes.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los ciudadanos de South Park están en peligro y los niños descubren que solo Al Gore puede ayudarlos.
programme.sub-title: Es hora de tomarlo en cereal

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos salen de la cárcel y huyen de la policía y del Hombre-Oso-Cerdo.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman ha sido diagnosticado con ansiedad.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: South Park es elegida para ser la sede del nuevo Centro de Distribución de Amazon.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La posibilidad de que los chicos ganen el desfile de bicis está en peligro cuando Kenny se retira.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Randy lucha contra la producción casera de mariguana. Kyle va a un centro de detención.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Randy ve una oportunidad para Tegridad en China.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Randy celebra el éxito de las Granjas Tegridad, mientras Cartman se reusa a ser vacunado.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman está seguro de que la nueva dieta basada en plantas en la cafetería de la escuela le causó un ataque al corazón

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Es Halloween y Randy está lidiando con el problema que tiene su hija con la marihuana.
programme.sub-title: Especial de Halloween de Granjas Tegridad

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los ciudadanos de South Park están cansados ​​de Randy y de Granjas Tegridad y solo quieren verlo arrestado.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La competencia anual Mujer Fuerte lleva a todos a sus límites.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La madre de Kyle se hace un trasplante fecal y los niños están en busca del mejor microbioma.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Scott Malkinson está desesperado por impresionar a la chica nueva de la escuela.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Papá Noel se está robando toda la alegría de la temporada navideña de la ciudad.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Randy asume su papel en el brote de Covid-19 mientras la pandemia presenta desafíos contínuos a los ciudadanos de South Park.
programme.sub-title: South Park: Episodio Especial de Pandemia

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los ciudadanos de South ParQ claman por la vacuna contra el COVID-19.
programme.sub-title: Especial de vacunación de South ParQ

programme.title: La nueva furia del dragón
programme.desc: Con Jackie Chan. Dos jóvenes lideran estudiantes chinos contra un maestro japonés.

programme.title: Doble amenaza
programme.desc: Una joven con doble personalidad arrastra a un hombre a una fuga entre mafiosos.

programme.desc: Cartman le insiste a sus amigos que los ataques terroristas del 11 de Septiembre fueron una conspiración y se dispone a desenmascarar la verdad. Por su parte, el Sr. Mackey quiere saber quién defecó en el baño.
programme.sub-title: El misterio del mojón en el urinal

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El Señor Garrison ha decidido hacerse un cambio de sexo y ahora se siente como una verdadera mujer. Mientras tanto, Kyle quiere hacerse una cirugía para ser negro y poder jugar en el equipo de básquetbol.
programme.sub-title: La nueva vagina del Señor Garrison

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Un día de diversión en el parque acuático se torna mortal para los niños.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Nueva Jersey se está expandiendo rápidamente y South Park está en peligro de convertirse en la siguiente ciudad en ser invadida. Randy y los chicos intentarán evitarlo.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Una nueva alumna llega a la escuela primaria de South Park y es negra por lo que Cartman cree que debería hacer pareja con Token, y no dejará que nadie se interponga en el camino, en especial Kyle.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos encuentran un antiguo objeto triangular en una excavación escolar. Luego de salir en el noticiero, Barbra Streisand aparece buscándolo ya que es lo que necesita para poder convertirse en un monstruo gigante japonés.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle está muy enfermo y su madre trata de curarlo con medicinas naturales de una curandera y sus colaboradores "nativos americanos”. Mientras, el señor Garrison es despedido y se convierte en un escritor de novelas románticas.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Randy propone un plan para arreglar la situación económica mundial. Mientras tanto, Stan intenta devolver una máquina para hacer margaritas, y un salvador inesperado hace el último sacrificio para resolver los problemas de todos.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: En "Imaginaciónlandia", Stan y Butters luchan contra un ejército de fuerzas imaginarias. La Suprema Corte declara que las criaturas imaginarias no son reales y planean destruir "Imaginaciónlandia".

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La última de las pruebas científicas revela que algunos de los chicos de South Park tiene un problema de adicción al sexo.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle firma un contrato con la empresa Apple sin leerlo previamente. Mientras tanto, Cartman enloquece a su mamá porque ésta no le compro un iPad.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El primo de Kyle, también llamado Kyle, llega de visita desde Connecticut, ya que su madre está enferma. A pesar de ser de la misma edad, los primos no tienen nada en común.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan y Kyle han sido capturados por el Pentágono para que le digan al gobierno exactamente cómo entraron a "Imaginaciónlandia". Mientras tanto, Cartman no se da por vencido en su apuesta con Kyle.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El show de Cartman es tendencia, mientras que el país se prepara para vivir la fiesta mas espectacular jamás vista.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle quiere jugar a los videojuegos con su hermano menor. Pero cuando Ike no quiere jugar más con él, Kyle teme que la próxima generación lo haya superado.

programme.title: La decisión de Sophie
programme.desc: Ganadora del Oscar a Mejor Actriz (Meryl Streep) y dirigida por Alan Pakula (El informe Pelícano). Stingo, un joven con ambiciones literarias se traslada a Brooklyn, donde conoce a una inmigrante polaca llamada Sophie, una superviviente de Auschwitz...

programme.title: El Lute: Camina o revienta
programme.desc: En 1960, una familia de quinquis recorre Extremadura. La vida tan dura que llevan causa la muerte de la madre. El hijo, Eleuterio Sánchez, roba unas gallinas y es condenado a seis meses de cárcel...

programme.title: Concursante
programme.desc: Martín Circo Martín, joven profesor, acaba de convertirse en el ganador del mayor premio jamás concedido en la Historia de la Televisión, valorado en más de 3 millones de euros. Sin embargo, Martín se ve en una trampa sin salida.

programme.title: Darkness
programme.desc: A una adolescente y su familia le suceden fenómenos extraños después de haberse mudado a una casa de campo.

programme.title: The dead girl
programme.desc: El asesinato de una joven reúne las historias de cinco mujeres: Lonely Arden descubre el cuerpo, Leah cree que la víctima puede ser su hermana desaparecida. Melora cree que es su hija, mientras que Ruth hace un descubrimiento aterrador.

programme.title: La caza
programme.desc: Tras un divorcio difícil, Lucas, de cuarenta años, ha conocido a otra mujer, tiene un nuevo trabajo y se dispone a reconstruir la relación con Marcus, su hijo adolescente. Pero algo va mal. Un detalle. Un comentario inocente. Una mentira fortuita.

programme.title: El Lobo
programme.desc: En este taquillazo del cine español Mikel Lejarza (Eduardo Noriega), alias "Lobo", fue un agente de los servicios secretos españoles que consiguió infiltrarse en ETA

programme.title: Mátalos suavemente
programme.desc: Un sicario es contratado para investigar un robo relacionado con la mafia.

programme.title: Prisioneros del sol
programme.desc: Una expedición multinacional descubre una ciudad perdida bajo una pirámide en la que tendrán que detener a los dioses del antiguo Egipto que han despertado para iniciar el apocalipsis.

programme.title: Un cuento de Navidad
programme.desc: Un viejo avaro amargado tiene la oportunidad de redimirse cuando se ve acechado por fantasmas en Nochebuena.

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: James Hunt y Niki Lauda, dos pilotos de Fórmula 1 extremadamente hábiles, mantienen entre sí una intensa rivalidad. Sin embargo, es su enemistad lo que les lleva al límite.

programme.title: Alienoid 1
programme.desc: Los guardianes extraterrestres usan huéspedes humanos como prisiones mientras un guardián rastrea a los fugitivos a través de los siglos, mezclando hechiceros taoístas de la dinastía Goryeo y tecnología futurista.

programme.title: Redada mortal
programme.desc: Un hábil luchador es contratado para neutralizar al equipo de seguridad de una fábrica local y permitir que su empleador extorsione a su poderoso dueño.

programme.title: Batalla espacial: La armada ataca
programme.desc: En 2420, después de que una raza de alienígenas y poderosos magos esclavizaran a gran parte de la humanidad, un grupo de rebeldes organiza un contraataque pilotando una flota de naves espaciales.

programme.title: White Space
programme.desc: La tripulación de una nave pesquera espacial se enfrenta a una criatura cósmica gigantesca y mortal mientras opera en un sector inexplorado del espacio.

programme.title: Robot Wasteland
programme.desc: En un mundo postapocalíptico dominado por máquinas rebeldes y bandas de saqueadores, una madre y su hija luchan por proteger la última fuente de agua limpia.

programme.title: La verdad puede matar
programme.desc: Un conductor enfrenta a la amante musulmana de su jefe fallecido y a su primo gánster.

programme.title: Las nuevas aventuras de Aladino
programme.desc: Dos empleados fracasados de unos grandes almacenes planean robar la tienda tras el cierre. Pero cuando un grupo de niños aparece pidiendo una historia, los hombres improvisan y empiezan a contar su propia versión del cuento de Aladino.

programme.title: Alpha
programme.desc: Tres amigos se ven obligados a separarse tras un atraco frustrado. Ocho años más tarde, el destino los vuelve a unir a pesar de haber tomado caminos muy distintos.

programme.title: Tras la pista del zorro
programme.desc: Aldo Vanucci (Peter Sellers), también conocido como "el Zorro", es un ingenioso y brillante ladrón. A lo largo de su agitada carrera, se ha hecho pasar por los más variados personajes, desde sacerdote a carabinero.

programme.title: El precio de la fama
programme.desc: Años 70 en Vevey, a orillas del lago Ginebra. Al salir de la cárcel, Eddy Ricaart va a casa de su amigo Osman Bricha. Han acordado que Eddy cuidará de Samira, la hija de Osman, mientras su esposa Noor está ingresada.

programme.title: El viaje del director de recursos humanos
programme.desc: El director de recursos humanos de la mayor panadería de Jerusalén tiene problemas. Se ha separado de su esposa; se ha distanciado de su hija, y está atrapado en un trabajo que le saca de quicio.

programme.title: Mi casa en París
programme.desc: Mathias, un desventurado neoyorquino sin esposa, sin hijos y sin un céntimo, hereda de su padre, con quien no se hablaba, una enorme en casa en París, de la que quiere deshacerse lo antes posible.

programme.title: Querida Elisabeth
programme.desc: La vida de Sid Straw se desmorona a medida que trata de demostrar a sus amigos que entabló amistad con una celebridad mientras estaba en la universidad.

programme.title: Los líos de Gray
programme.desc: Gray y Sam (Heather Graham y Tom Cavanagh) son hermanos, pero tan compatibles e inseparables que la gente cree que son pareja.

programme.title: Atraco por duplicado
programme.desc: Cuando le toman como rehén durante el atraco a un banco, un hombre se propone proteger a la guapa cajera de la que se ha enamorado perdidamente.

programme.title: Con la magia en los zapatos
programme.desc: Un zapatero, aburrido de su vida cotidiana, tropieza con una reliquia mágica que le permite convertirse en otras personas y ver el mundo de otra manera.

programme.title: Memoria Perdida
programme.desc: Un periodista con pérdida de memoria regresa a su pueblo natal y se reencuentra con su tío y antiguo amor.

programme.title: El club de los incomprendidos
programme.desc: Basada en la novela de Francisco de Paula. Un grupo de adolescentes castigados en el instituto descubre la amistad y el amor mientras comparten sus problemas. En elenco podemos ver a Ivana Baquero, Patrick Criado, Aitana Sánchez-Gijón o Raúl Arévalo.

programme.title: Obsession
programme.desc: Sonia Paston acepta una gran promoción laboral que significa dejar su vida en Nueva York para mudarse a un pequeño pueblo cerca de Boston. Aún si ella esta lista para irse, alguien no esta dispuesto a vivir sin ella.

programme.title: El intruso
programme.desc: Tras un trágico accidente, un hombre se convierte en el objetivo de la peligrosa obsesión de otro testigo.

programme.title: El general murió al amanecer
programme.desc: En los años 30, en plena guerra civil china, el aventurero O'Hara, indignado por el trato que el general Yang dispensa a sus compatriotas, envía dinero al señor Wu para que compre en Shangai armas.

programme.title: Moebius
programme.desc: En un futuro no muy lejano, un misterioso accidente ocurre en el metro de Buenos Aires: un coche que circulaba por la vía desaparece, perdiéndose en el tiempo debido a un extraño fenómeno que solo un científico puede resolver.

programme.title: The Ghost Writer
programme.desc: El cineasta Roman Polanski aumenta el suspense en un thriller sobre un escritor (Ewan McGregor) que redacta las memorias de un ex primer ministro (Pierce Brosnan).

programme.title: Crupier
programme.desc: Jack Manfred, un aspirante a escritor con problemas económicos, decide aceptar un trabajo de croupier para salir adelante. Lo malo es que en el casino entabla relación con una empleada que lo arrastra por caminos peligrosos.

programme.title: Brimstone. La hija del predicador
programme.desc: A finales del siglo XIX, Liz es una madre joven que intenta huir de su pasado mientras es perseguida por un diabólico predicador, que ha llegado al pueblo donde vive ella.

programme.title: Policías de Queens
programme.desc: Al Pacino, Channing Tatum y Ray Liotta protagonizan un thriller criminal. Un joven policía (Channing Tatum) es destinado a una comisaría del barrio en el que se crio, donde un antiguo secreto amenaza con destruir a su familia.

programme.title: Door Lock
programme.desc: Cuando Kyung-min, una joven que trabaja y vive sola, un día ve la cerradura de su puerta abierta y, preocupada, cambia su contraseña. Esa noche alguien intenta abrir su puerta. Unos días después, alguien es asesinado en su edificio de oficinas.

programme.title: Una cita de muerte
programme.desc: Un marido y una mujer, por separado y sin saberlo, conspiran para asesinarse mutuamente en la misma fatídica noche.

programme.title: Un mes en el campo
programme.desc: Tras la Primera Guerra Mundial, Tom Birkin llega a un pueblo del norte de Inglaterra para restaurar un antiguo mural oculto en una iglesia. Su presencia despierta el recelo del reverendo y de unos vecinos reacios a cambiar el orden establecido.

programme.title: Compassionate Sex
programme.desc: En una desolada aldea, Dolores, una mujer bondadosa, madura, gordita y cariñosa cincuentona, es abandonada por su marido, hastiado de su excesiva generosidad.

programme.title: Cowards
programme.desc: Historia de dos chavales de secundaria, uno la víctima y el otro el verdugo. Guille es, en apariencia, un chico como muchos: buenas notas, buen deportista y con una familia que le respalda.

programme.title: Salto al vacío
programme.desc: Alex es una chica de 20 años que se hace cargo de la manutención de su familia con el tráfico ilegal de armas. Es la única chica en un mundo de hombres, dividida entre la necesidad de encontrar el amor y una vida basada en la violencia.

programme.title: Escándalo
programme.desc: La historia sigue el romance entre una bailarina exótica y el ministro de Guerra, una relación que sacude al gobierno británico. Basada en el escándalo Profumo de 1963.

programme.title: El Taller de escritura
programme.desc: Antoine ha aceptado formar parte de un taller de escritura donde unos jóvenes, como parte de un programa de integración social, deben escribir una novela con la ayuda de Olivia, una conocida escritora.

programme.title: House of Cards ES
programme.desc: Una madre lucha por comprender el por qué su hija se retira a su propio mundo de silencio. La historia prosigue el trabajo de Ruth Matthews (Kathleen Turner) y su difunto esposo restaurando ruinas mayas, un trabajo que causó la muerte de él un año antes.

programme.title: Todo por un sueño
programme.desc: Suzanne sueña con convertirse en una presentadora estrella de la televisión. No quiere que nada ni nadie se interponga en su camino. Por esa razón intentará eliminar a su marido, que representa un gran obstáculo para su carrera.

programme.title: La caza
programme.desc: Tras un divorcio difícil, Lucas, de cuarenta años, ha conocido a otra mujer, tiene un nuevo trabajo y se dispone a reconstruir la relación con Marcus, su hijo adolescente. Pero algo va mal. Un detalle. Un comentario inocente. Una mentira fortuita.

programme.title: Shopping (De tiendas)
programme.desc: La guerra entre la policía y las bandas juveniles se agrava porque sólo los agentes están obligados a pelear sin armas. Billy, intenta recuperar su puesto al ver que tras su salida de la cárcel Tommy ha ocupado su lugar al frente del grupo.

programme.title: La señorita Julia
programme.desc: Una noche de verano en una mansión en el campo irlandés en 1880. La película explora la lucha de poder entre una joven aristócrata y el criado de su padre.

programme.title: El amor no es lo que era
programme.desc: Tres historias de amor que se desarrollan en la misma ciudad. Paz y Jorge llevan tres años casados pero su matrimonio no funciona, la relación se está apagando y ninguno de los dos encuentra la solución.

programme.title: La fuente de los deseos
programme.desc: La propietaria de una tienda de mascotas de San Francisco se reencuentra con su primer amor y debe resistirse a enamorarse de él por segunda vez.

programme.title: Red Dog, una historia de lealtad

programme.title: Jimmy Witherspoon & Rozaa Wortham
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Jimmy Witherspoon and Rozaa Wortham, two incredible brilliant jazz musicians. Rozaa Wortham starts off the show with the Jimmy Witherspoon Quartet. Swinging and full of energy she performs ‘It Don't Mean A Thing'. Jimmy Witherspoon, known for the song “Ain't Nobody's Business” ends the show with some astounding lean-back blues.

programme.title: Kenny Barron
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron's June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine's Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet). Their seamless blend of classic bebop and modern explorations spoke of a deep, emotive connection to each note, captivating the Ukrainian audience with lyrical improvisations during this unforgettable concert.

programme.title: Wilton Felder, Joe Sample, Reichii Guillory & Eddie Davis
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. The Crusaders, an American jazz fusion group that was popular in the '70s employed a two-manned front-line horn section. The group's sound was rooted in hard bop, with an emphasis on R&B and soul. Their performance at Estival is beyond soulful and an amazing show to watch.

programme.title: Dizzy Gillespie, Tony Coe, Derek Humble & Billy Mitchell
programme.desc: American jazz trumpeter, composer, and bandleader Dizzy Gillespie (1917-1993) was one of the seminal figures of the bebop movement. He fuses all musical forms rooted in African culture, such as music from Cuba, Latin America and the Caribbean, into his music. On November 4, 1970 he played a concert in Denmark with the Kenny Clarke/Francy Boland Big Band, performing Con Alma, Brother K, Now Hear My Meanin', Manteca, Let Me Outta Here, and Things Are Here.

programme.title: Lionel Hampton
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Bootsy Collins
programme.sub-title: Casper the Funky Ghost: Bootsy Collins à Vienne
programme.desc: Bootsy Collins, famed for playing with George Clinton and his very own Rubber Band, is used to playing syncopated, hard and relentlessly rhythmic music. With this unique style Bootsy was a major influence on the development of funk. Now in his 60s, the bassist seems animated by a new energy that reflects his new work on the album ‘Tha Funk Capitol of the World'. With this album, Bootsy Collins pays tribute to the artists with whom he worked during his frantic career: from James Brown and Parliament-Funkadelic to Fatboy Slim. During this concert, recorded at the festival Jazz à Vienne, Bootsy maintains that same energy, giving a spectacular show.

programme.title: Ray Charles & The Raelettes
programme.sub-title: Ray Charles and the Raelettes - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1980, American soul legend Ray Charles brought the Raelettes and the Ray Charles Orchestra to the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. With the full force of these two groups behind him, Charles showed why throughout his storied career he has been viewed as one of the most recognizable voices in music.

programme.title: Elizabeth Shepherd
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Duke Ellington
programme.sub-title: Duke Ellington: Jazz from Newport, Brussels, 1973
programme.desc: In 1956, Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed a legendary set at the third annual Newport Jazz Festival. It was tenor saxophonist Paul Gonsalves' outstanding 27-chorus solo on “Diminuendo and Crescendo in Blue” that revitalized Ellington's career. The success generated during that performance carried him for the rest of his life. By 1973, festivals carrying the Newport name were organized all over the world. Less than a year before his death, Ellington and his Orchestra, with Gonsalves still in the fold, appeared in Brussels to deliver a timeless performance before a highly appreciative crowd.

programme.title: Eduard Topchjan & Armenian Philharmonic Orchestra
programme.desc: Conductor Eduard Topchjan leads the Armenian National Philharmonic Orchestra in a performance of Hector Berlioz's Symphonie fantastique, Op. 14. Berlioz wrote the piece of program music in 1830 while still a conservatory student. Inspired on the composer's unrequited love for Irish actress Harriet Smithson, the five-movement piece portrays the dreams of a young artist who has taken an overdose of opium in the aftermath of a failed love affair. Berlioz used one melody in each movement of the work representing the artist's beloved, an ‘idée fixe' (a fixed idea or obsession). The work is scored for a large orchestra and features an astonishing array of instrumental colors, including church bells, an off-stage oboe, and strings playing col legno (using the wood of their bow). This performance was recorded at the Aram Khachaturian Concert Hall in Yerevan, Armenia, in 2021.

programme.title: Russian National Orchestra & Mikhail Pletnev
programme.desc: Russian conductor and pianist Mikhail Pletnev leads the Russian National Orchestra in performances of Nikolai Rimsky-Korsakov's music. On the program are Suite for Orchestra after the opera 'The Legend of the Invisible City of Kitezh and the Maiden Fevroniya', and Musical Pictures for Orchestra from the opera 'The Tale of Tsar Saltan'. Part of the latter is the famous 'Flight of the Bumblebee'. This concert was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall of the Russian Philharmonic Society in 2017.

programme.title: Kazuki Yamada & Orchestre National du Capitole de Toulouse
programme.desc: 2024 marks the 100th anniversary of Gabriel Fauré's death. He is considered one of the most important and influential composers, having been the teacher of Maurice Ravel, Georges Enescu, Nadia Boulanger and many others. The Orchestre National du Capitole de Toulouse and The Philharmonic Chorus of Tokyo, with Florian Sempey as soloist, perform Gabriel Fauré's Requiem in the Basilique de Saint-Sernin in Toulouse, the largest surviving Romanesque church in France and one of the most important buildings in Romanesque architecture. This extraordinary concert is conducted by Kazuki Yamada, who is currently one of the most exciting young maestros. In spring 2023, he was appointed Principal Conductor and Artistic Advisor of the City of Birmingham Symphony Orchestra, and is also Artistic and Musical Director of the Orchestre Philharmonique de Monte-Carlo.

programme.title: Evgeny Kissin, Nikolai Demidenko, Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra & Antoni Wit
programme.desc: Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performances of Chopin's Piano Concertos No. 1, Op. 11 and No. 2, Op. 21. Soloists are Nikolai Demidenko and Evgeny Kissin. After performing the first concerto, Demidenko encores with Chopin's Mazurka Op. 17/4. Kissin closes the concert with Chopin's Etude Op. 10/12 and the Waltz in E minor, Op. post. This concert was part of the celebration of Chopin's 200th anniversary in 2010. Chopin composed the second concerto one year before the Concerto No. 1 and completed both works at the age of 20, before leaving his home country Poland and moving to Paris.

programme.title: Philippe Jordan & Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven's symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven's Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36. Completed in 1802, the work saw its first performance at the Theater an der Wien on April 5, 1803. That same concert also included the premieres of the composer's Piano Concerto No. 3 and his only oratorio, Christ on the Mount of Olives, as well as a reprise performance of his Symphony No. 1. Instead of the traditional minuet, Beethoven wrote a lively scherzo as the third movement of his Symphony No 2. The overall mood of the work is optimistic. Jordan's performance was recorded at Palais Garnier in Paris, France, in 2014.

programme.title: Christian Zacharias, Orchestre National de Lille & Isabelle van Keulen
programme.sub-title: Schumann - Violin Concerto and Symphony No. 1
programme.desc: German conductor Christian Zacharias leads the Orchestre national de Lille in a concert program dedicated to Robert Schumann. The concert opens with the ‘Genoveva' Overture, Op. 81. Although Schumann's only opera Genoveva is not often performed, its overture established itself as an autonomous work in concert halls. After, the composer's Violin Concerto in D minor, WoO 23, is performed, featuring Dutch violinist Isabelle van Keulen as the soloist. Written in 1853, it is Schumann's only violin concerto. The concert ends with a performance of Schumann's Symphony No. 1 in B-flat major, Op. 38, also known as the ‘Spring Symphony'. This optimistic work is written in 1841 and is the most performed of Schumann's four symphonies. This concert was recorded at Auditorium du Nouveau Siècle in Lille, France, on June 16, 2017.

programme.title: Diana Krall
programme.desc: Diana Krall has had a long time fascination with bossa nova, a type of music which perfectly suits her sophisticated yet sensual style. This culminated in her new studio album 'Quiet Nights' (released by Verve in spring 2009) and in this stunning concert filmed in the home of the bossa nova, Rio de Janeiro, in November 2008. Accompanied by her band and an orchestra, Diana Krall delivers a superb live performance of standards in true bossa nova style but clearly bearing her unique stamp. This concert captures Diana Krall at her scintillating best.

programme.title: Milky Chance
programme.desc: The German duet is back and better than ever! Milky Chance is the success story of two school friends, Clemens Rehbein and Philipp Dausch. After a long break, 2017 marks the release of a second, long-waited, album "Blossom". And, for the public, finally the occasion to discover live these new compositions, mixing rock, folk and electro pop. With reggae vibrations that can rub shoulders with house elements, Milky Chance has one of the most singular sounds. With the presence of musicians on stage, and if we believe the listening of the new record, we can expect more electric concerts, more electronic and even more energetic than in the past!

programme.title: Rainbow Reef Relaxation 2
programme.desc: Sit back, relax and enjoy the dazzling world of coral reefs in 4K you embark on a journey through some of the most vibrant underwater reefs on our blue planet - including many scenes which no longer look like this due to coral bleaching. From the cinematographer: "The footage for this film was shot over a period of some years in French Polynesia, Micronesia, Indonesia and East Timor. Unfortunately there are not that vibrant anymore today. Coral reefs have suffered from the rise of water temperature, rise in acidity, destructive fishing methods and severe storms caused by climate change." - Peter Schneider. "Rainbow Reef Relaxation" is a 3-hour long, sweeping yet majestic & vibrant underwater journey to the world's most beautiful lagoons, as captured by Nature Relaxation collaborator Peter Schneider (Underwatercam) paired with ambient underwater sounds and brand new ambient music by the Cynic Project. Filmed in High Definition several years ago, thanks to its age this film offers magical glimpses of an underwater world that is bursting with life, color, and beauty.

programme.title: Jimmy Witherspoon & Rozaa Wortham
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Jimmy Witherspoon and Rozaa Wortham, two incredible brilliant jazz musicians. Rozaa Wortham starts off the show with the Jimmy Witherspoon Quartet. Swinging and full of energy she performs ‘It Don't Mean A Thing'. Jimmy Witherspoon, known for the song “Ain't Nobody's Business” ends the show with some astounding lean-back blues.

programme.title: Kenny Barron
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron's June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine's Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet). Their seamless blend of classic bebop and modern explorations spoke of a deep, emotive connection to each note, captivating the Ukrainian audience with lyrical improvisations during this unforgettable concert.

programme.title: Wilton Felder, Joe Sample, Reichii Guillory & Eddie Davis
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. The Crusaders, an American jazz fusion group that was popular in the '70s employed a two-manned front-line horn section. The group's sound was rooted in hard bop, with an emphasis on R&B and soul. Their performance at Estival is beyond soulful and an amazing show to watch.

programme.title: Dizzy Gillespie, Tony Coe, Derek Humble & Billy Mitchell
programme.desc: American jazz trumpeter, composer, and bandleader Dizzy Gillespie (1917-1993) was one of the seminal figures of the bebop movement. He fuses all musical forms rooted in African culture, such as music from Cuba, Latin America and the Caribbean, into his music. On November 4, 1970 he played a concert in Denmark with the Kenny Clarke/Francy Boland Big Band, performing Con Alma, Brother K, Now Hear My Meanin', Manteca, Let Me Outta Here, and Things Are Here.

programme.title: Lionel Hampton
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Bootsy Collins
programme.sub-title: Casper the Funky Ghost: Bootsy Collins à Vienne
programme.desc: Bootsy Collins, famed for playing with George Clinton and his very own Rubber Band, is used to playing syncopated, hard and relentlessly rhythmic music. With this unique style Bootsy was a major influence on the development of funk. Now in his 60s, the bassist seems animated by a new energy that reflects his new work on the album ‘Tha Funk Capitol of the World'. With this album, Bootsy Collins pays tribute to the artists with whom he worked during his frantic career: from James Brown and Parliament-Funkadelic to Fatboy Slim. During this concert, recorded at the festival Jazz à Vienne, Bootsy maintains that same energy, giving a spectacular show.

programme.title: Ray Charles & The Raelettes
programme.sub-title: Ray Charles and the Raelettes - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1980, American soul legend Ray Charles brought the Raelettes and the Ray Charles Orchestra to the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. With the full force of these two groups behind him, Charles showed why throughout his storied career he has been viewed as one of the most recognizable voices in music.

programme.title: Elizabeth Shepherd
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Duke Ellington
programme.sub-title: Duke Ellington: Jazz from Newport, Brussels, 1973
programme.desc: In 1956, Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed a legendary set at the third annual Newport Jazz Festival. It was tenor saxophonist Paul Gonsalves' outstanding 27-chorus solo on “Diminuendo and Crescendo in Blue” that revitalized Ellington's career. The success generated during that performance carried him for the rest of his life. By 1973, festivals carrying the Newport name were organized all over the world. Less than a year before his death, Ellington and his Orchestra, with Gonsalves still in the fold, appeared in Brussels to deliver a timeless performance before a highly appreciative crowd.

programme.title: Eduard Topchjan & Armenian Philharmonic Orchestra
programme.desc: Conductor Eduard Topchjan leads the Armenian National Philharmonic Orchestra in a performance of Hector Berlioz's Symphonie fantastique, Op. 14. Berlioz wrote the piece of program music in 1830 while still a conservatory student. Inspired on the composer's unrequited love for Irish actress Harriet Smithson, the five-movement piece portrays the dreams of a young artist who has taken an overdose of opium in the aftermath of a failed love affair. Berlioz used one melody in each movement of the work representing the artist's beloved, an ‘idée fixe' (a fixed idea or obsession). The work is scored for a large orchestra and features an astonishing array of instrumental colors, including church bells, an off-stage oboe, and strings playing col legno (using the wood of their bow). This performance was recorded at the Aram Khachaturian Concert Hall in Yerevan, Armenia, in 2021.

programme.title: Russian National Orchestra & Mikhail Pletnev
programme.desc: Russian conductor and pianist Mikhail Pletnev leads the Russian National Orchestra in performances of Nikolai Rimsky-Korsakov's music. On the program are Suite for Orchestra after the opera 'The Legend of the Invisible City of Kitezh and the Maiden Fevroniya', and Musical Pictures for Orchestra from the opera 'The Tale of Tsar Saltan'. Part of the latter is the famous 'Flight of the Bumblebee'. This concert was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall of the Russian Philharmonic Society in 2017.

programme.title: Kazuki Yamada & Orchestre National du Capitole de Toulouse
programme.desc: 2024 marks the 100th anniversary of Gabriel Fauré's death. He is considered one of the most important and influential composers, having been the teacher of Maurice Ravel, Georges Enescu, Nadia Boulanger and many others. The Orchestre National du Capitole de Toulouse and The Philharmonic Chorus of Tokyo, with Florian Sempey as soloist, perform Gabriel Fauré's Requiem in the Basilique de Saint-Sernin in Toulouse, the largest surviving Romanesque church in France and one of the most important buildings in Romanesque architecture. This extraordinary concert is conducted by Kazuki Yamada, who is currently one of the most exciting young maestros. In spring 2023, he was appointed Principal Conductor and Artistic Advisor of the City of Birmingham Symphony Orchestra, and is also Artistic and Musical Director of the Orchestre Philharmonique de Monte-Carlo.

programme.title: Evgeny Kissin, Nikolai Demidenko, Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra & Antoni Wit
programme.desc: Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performances of Chopin's Piano Concertos No. 1, Op. 11 and No. 2, Op. 21. Soloists are Nikolai Demidenko and Evgeny Kissin. After performing the first concerto, Demidenko encores with Chopin's Mazurka Op. 17/4. Kissin closes the concert with Chopin's Etude Op. 10/12 and the Waltz in E minor, Op. post. This concert was part of the celebration of Chopin's 200th anniversary in 2010. Chopin composed the second concerto one year before the Concerto No. 1 and completed both works at the age of 20, before leaving his home country Poland and moving to Paris.

programme.title: Philippe Jordan & Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven's symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven's Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36. Completed in 1802, the work saw its first performance at the Theater an der Wien on April 5, 1803. That same concert also included the premieres of the composer's Piano Concerto No. 3 and his only oratorio, Christ on the Mount of Olives, as well as a reprise performance of his Symphony No. 1. Instead of the traditional minuet, Beethoven wrote a lively scherzo as the third movement of his Symphony No 2. The overall mood of the work is optimistic. Jordan's performance was recorded at Palais Garnier in Paris, France, in 2014.

programme.title: Christian Zacharias, Orchestre National de Lille & Isabelle van Keulen
programme.sub-title: Schumann - Violin Concerto and Symphony No. 1
programme.desc: German conductor Christian Zacharias leads the Orchestre national de Lille in a concert program dedicated to Robert Schumann. The concert opens with the ‘Genoveva' Overture, Op. 81. Although Schumann's only opera Genoveva is not often performed, its overture established itself as an autonomous work in concert halls. After, the composer's Violin Concerto in D minor, WoO 23, is performed, featuring Dutch violinist Isabelle van Keulen as the soloist. Written in 1853, it is Schumann's only violin concerto. The concert ends with a performance of Schumann's Symphony No. 1 in B-flat major, Op. 38, also known as the ‘Spring Symphony'. This optimistic work is written in 1841 and is the most performed of Schumann's four symphonies. This concert was recorded at Auditorium du Nouveau Siècle in Lille, France, on June 16, 2017.

programme.title: James Morrison
programme.desc: T in the Park festival is a major Scottish music festival that has been held almost annually since 1994 (the event did not take place in 2017). It is named after its main sponsor, the brewing company Tennents.

programme.title: Leonard Cohen
programme.desc: Rare performance footage, studio recordings, interviews, rarely seen photographs, location shoots alongside contributions from some of Cohen's closest colleagues.

programme.title: Diana Krall
programme.desc: Diana Krall has had a long time fascination with bossa nova, a type of music which perfectly suits her sophisticated yet sensual style. This culminated in her new studio album 'Quiet Nights' (released by Verve in spring 2009) and in this stunning concert filmed in the home of the bossa nova, Rio de Janeiro, in November 2008. Accompanied by her band and an orchestra, Diana Krall delivers a superb live performance of standards in true bossa nova style but clearly bearing her unique stamp. This concert captures Diana Krall at her scintillating best.

programme.title: Beyoncé
programme.desc: The Sound Of Change was a benefit concert held at Twickenham Stadium, London, England, as part of the Chime For Change initiative, founded by Beyoncé with the help of actress Salma Hayek and Gucci's creative director, Frida Giannini.

programme.title: Maroon 5
programme.desc: Filmed at Roundhouse, London, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Classic Maroon 5 featuring unforgettable version of their hits: 'Moves Like Jagger', 'Daylight', 'This Love' and many more…

programme.title: Milky Chance
programme.desc: The German duet is back and better than ever! Milky Chance is the success story of two school friends, Clemens Rehbein and Philipp Dausch. After a long break, 2017 marks the release of a second, long-waited, album "Blossom". And, for the public, finally the occasion to discover live these new compositions, mixing rock, folk and electro pop. With reggae vibrations that can rub shoulders with house elements, Milky Chance has one of the most singular sounds. With the presence of musicians on stage, and if we believe the listening of the new record, we can expect more electric concerts, more electronic and even more energetic than in the past!

programme.title: Rainbow Reef Relaxation 2
programme.desc: Sit back, relax and enjoy the dazzling world of coral reefs in 4K you embark on a journey through some of the most vibrant underwater reefs on our blue planet - including many scenes which no longer look like this due to coral bleaching. From the cinematographer: "The footage for this film was shot over a period of some years in French Polynesia, Micronesia, Indonesia and East Timor. Unfortunately there are not that vibrant anymore today. Coral reefs have suffered from the rise of water temperature, rise in acidity, destructive fishing methods and severe storms caused by climate change." - Peter Schneider. "Rainbow Reef Relaxation" is a 3-hour long, sweeping yet majestic & vibrant underwater journey to the world's most beautiful lagoons, as captured by Nature Relaxation collaborator Peter Schneider (Underwatercam) paired with ambient underwater sounds and brand new ambient music by the Cynic Project. Filmed in High Definition several years ago, thanks to its age this film offers magical glimpses of an underwater world that is bursting with life, color, and beauty.

programme.title: La última batalla de los apaches

Solo un chico sabe que los asesinatos fueron en realidad perpetrados por un grupo de hombres despiadados que pretenden empezar una guerra entre indios y colonos. Old Shatterhand trata de limpiar el nombre de su amigo Winnetou y se dispone a seguir la pista que le llevará justo detrás del fuerte de caballería.

programme.title: Sangre en la pradera

programme.title: The brave
programme.desc: Raphael debe encontrar un trabajo urgentemente para sacar a su familia de la miseria. Un misterioso personaje le ofrece dinero…

programme.title: La vida de Brian
programme.desc: Brian nace en un pesebre de Belén el mismo día que Jesucristo. Un cúmulo de desgraciados y tronchantes equívocos le harán llevar una vida paralela a la del verdadero Hijo de Dios.

programme.title: ¡Agáchate, maldito!

programme.title: El dulce porvenir
